title: Reconcile lint fragmentation and consolidate dev dependencies
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Over the life of the monorepo we accumulated multiple per-package lint configs, ad-hoc devDependencies, and slightly different lint invocation scripts. This results in noisy CI, duplicated devdeps, and frequent 'works-locally/CI-fails' cycles. This PR centralizes lint configuration and unifies dev dependency management for developer tooling while preserving per-package overrides where necessary. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce tools/lintctl: a lightweight shim that normalizes lint invocations across packages and wraps eslint/tsc/clang-format with consistent env and cache behavior. 2) Add dev-deps.json at repo root that contains canonical dev tooling versions (eslint, typescript, prettier, @redwood/eslint-config, dep-warrant). Per-package package.json files now reference the root dev-deps via a migration script (scripts/migrate-per-package-lint.sh). 3) Consolidate individual .eslintrc.* files into a small hierarchy: .eslintrc.base.json at repo root plus package-level minimal overrides. 4) Replace multiple husky hooks with a centralized commit-msg and pre-commit hook managed by tools/lintctl to keep hook logic in one place. 5) CI changes: update ci/workflows/lint.yml to add lint-fastpath (changed-files heuristic), lint-full (sharded by language), deps-scan (uses dep-warrant to assert allowed transitive dev deps) and a cache-warm job for node_modules/tooling cache. 6) Add migration docs: docs/dev/linting.md with troubleshooting and roll-back steps. Checklist: - [x] Add lintctl shim and basic tests - [x] Create dev-deps.json and migration script - [x] Update CI (lint workflows, cache keys) - [x] Update developer docs and announce in #dev - [x] Run repo-wide migration and fix linter violations - [x] Smoke test on CI and dogfood in internal service Canary notes: The migration script is idempotent and will only alter package.json if dev-scripts or lint entries differ from the canonical form. A feature gate (CI_LINT_PROFILE) allows teams to opt into the new lint profile in CI during a staged rollout. Rollout plan: - Day 0: Merge behind feature flag, enable lint-fastpath by default. - Day 1-2: Monitor lint failures and CI time; fix top noisy packages. - Day 3: Enable lint-full for all jobs. - Day 7: Remove legacy per-package lint scripts and husky copies. Testing performed: - Local migration against 150 packages (dry-run mode) - CI runs on fork and branch (lint-fastpath + lint-full) - dep-warrant scan over current lockfiles to build allowlist - Metrics: reduced lint CI time by ~28% on average using lint-fastpath + cache split Risks & mitigations: - Risk: Unexpected package-specific rules lost. Mitigation: package-level overrides preserved; migration script respects existing "override: true" markers. - Risk: Third-party tools pinned at incompatible versions. Mitigation: dev-deps.json uses a compatibility matrix and automatic canary rollout via CI. Related: ENG-1452 (lint stability), ENG-2120 (dev toolchain consolidation).

review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Can we split the migration into smaller commits? The combined migration + fixes makes bisecting harder. Suggest keeping the script addition separate from auto-fixed lint changes.
Maya Chen: Split into two logical commits during squash; the migration script is first, followed by automated fixes. Will keep a clear changelog entry.
Priya Nair: Confirmed dep-warrant policy; please add a brief note in docs about how to extend allowlist.
Jordan Kim: CI cache key looks good but please add fallback on cache-miss to avoid extended cold runs.
Diego Alvarez: Approved after the CI run stabilized and a follow-up hotfix to relax a strict rule in packages/service-a.
release_notes: Centralized lint config and dev-tooling versions. Introduces tools/lintctl, dev-deps.json, and new CI lint stages (fastpath + sharded full lint). Migration fixes applied. No runtime changes expected.
notes: This change is repo-hygiene focused. Operations: team leads should opt their services into the new profile by removing old 'lint' script variants or adding a short override marker. The migration script prints a per-package report and leaves backups under scripts/migration-backups/.
auto_backout_plan: If lint regressions spike after merge, flip CI_LINT_PROFILE back to legacy in CI variables and run a one-time job to restore package.json backups; follow the rollback steps in docs/dev/linting.md
